selection_contract: One dataset-level setting per method selected on the complete Development split; no per-case oracle and no Holdout/Test tuning.
failure_fallback: Exact R0 identity transform with the case retained in the fixed denominator.
r1_definition: Prediction-only boundary-person matching followed by coordinate-wise median pelvis translation; one shared translation is applied to all post-cut cameras, people, meshes, and scene points.
r2_definition: The same prediction-only person matching followed by RANSAC and weighted Kabsch over stable predicted body joints; one shared SE(3) is applied to all post-cut outputs.
